items.source: Note that BeanDefinitionRegistryPostProcessor types may not be registered here, due to lifecycle constraints related to @Configuration class processing.
items.translation: 请注意，由于与 `@Configuration` 类处理相关的生活周期限制，BeanDefinitionRegistryPostProcessor 类型可能无法在此注册。

items.source: Along with @Configuration and ImportSelector, classes of this type may be provided to the @Import annotation (or may also be returned from an ImportSelector).
items.translation: 与 `@Configuration` 和 ImportSelector 一起，此类类的实例可以提供给 `@Import` 注解（或者也可以从 `ImportSelector` 返回）。

items.source: See implementations and associated unit tests for usage examples.
items.translation: 查看实现和相关的单元测试以获取使用示例。

items.source: Register bean definitions as necessary based on the given annotation metadata of the importing @Configuration class.
items.translation: 根据导入的 `@Configuration` 类的注解元数据，注册必要的 Bean 定义。

items.source: importBeanNameGenerator - the bean name generator strategy for imported beans: ConfigurationClassPostProcessor.IMPORT_BEAN_NAME_GENERATOR by default, or a user-provided one if ConfigurationClassPostProcessor.setBeanNameGenerator(BeanNameGenerator) has been set. In the latter case, the passed-in strategy will be the same used for component scanning in the containing application context (otherwise, the default component-scan naming strategy is AnnotationBeanNameGenerator.INSTANCE).
items.translation: importBeanNameGenerator - 导入 Bean 的 Bean 名称生成器策略：默认为ConfigurationClassPostProcessor.IMPORT_BEAN_NAME_GENERATOR，或者如果已设置ConfigurationClassPostProcessor.setBeanNameGenerator(BeanNameGenerator)，则为用户提供的生成器。在后一种情况下，传入的策略将与包含应用程序上下文中组件扫描使用的策略相同（否则，默认的组件扫描命名策略为AnnotationBeanNameGenerator.INSTANCE）。

items.source: importingClassMetadata - annotation metadata of the importing class

items.translation: registry - 当前 Bean 定义注册表
